health.label: Health
health.meaning: Current or maximum HP; reaching zero ends the descent unless saved.

stamina.label: Stamina
stamina.meaning: Physical activation budget; refills each round. A yellow AA battery represents stamina/energy, distinct from the blue mana gem.

mana.label: Mana
mana.meaning: Magical activation budget; refills each round. Costs allocate by explicit priority then backpack reading order; unused mana does not accumulate.

block.label: Block
block.meaning: Persistent protection pool used by players and enemies. Absorbed strikes spend it; excess hits health. Only explicit effects restore it.

plating.label: Plating
plating.meaning: Reduces every enemy strike before the shared Block pool is spent; the same Plating value protects every strike and strengthens Warrior Riposte.

slow.label: Slow
slow.meaning: Reduces every enemy strike this turn before spending block; combines with plating.

healing.label: Healing
healing.meaning: Restores HP before attacks resolve, capped at maximum HP.

vampirism.label: Vampirism
vampirism.meaning: Restores HP from actual direct damage dealt, capped at the vampirism value; overkill adds no healing.

ward.label: Ward
ward.meaning: Shared pool absorbs curse, poison and reflected damage this turn, not ordinary strikes or Arcane Barter HP cost.

poison.label: Poison
poison.meaning: Stacks deal damage after direct attacks and normally decay by one each turn; bypass enemy shields.

burn.label: Burn
burn.meaning: Burning enemy stacks deal damage after direct attacks, bypass shields, decay by one each turn.

curse.label: Curse
curse.meaning: Per-turn HP cost from cursed items, absorbed by ward before health.

thorns.label: Thorns
thorns.meaning: Retaliation damage after every enemy strike, including blocked strikes; bypasses enemy shields and can stop remaining strikes by killing the attacker.

damage.label: Damage
damage.meaning: Combined direct damage from weapons, bows, spells and bone thralls; enemy shield absorbs it first, excess reaches health; poison, burn and retaliation are separate.

cleanse.label: Cleanse
cleanse.meaning: Removes poison stacks from the player before poison deals damage; does not remove enemy poison.

crit_chance.label: Crit chance
crit_chance.meaning: Visual identity for crit chance only; no current combat definition or formula is assigned.

critical_damage.label: Critical damage
critical_damage.meaning: Visual identity for critical damage only; no current combat definition or formula is assigned.

magical_attack.label: Magical attack
magical_attack.meaning: Visual identity for magical attack only; no current combat definition or formula is assigned.

total_attack.label: Total attack
total_attack.meaning: Visual identity for total attack only; no current combat definition or formula is assigned.

physical_attack.label: Physical attack
physical_attack.meaning: Visual identity for physical attack only; no current combat definition or formula is assigned.

accuracy.label: Accuracy
accuracy.meaning: Visual identity for accuracy only; no current combat definition or formula is assigned.

toughness.label: Toughness
toughness.meaning: Visual identity for toughness only; no current combat definition or formula is assigned.

luck.label: Luck
luck.meaning: Visual identity for luck only; no current combat definition or formula is assigned.

doom.label: Doom
doom.meaning: Visual identity for doom only; no current combat definition or formula is assigned.
